Continue the Pattern Rules

A row of symbols follows a pattern. Tap the symbol that comes next.

The rules

The goal
A game has 6 rows. In each row a few symbols repeat again and again, and the last place is empty. Tap the symbol that belongs there. Then tap Next for the following row.
Right and wrong
The right symbol moves into the empty place. A wrong symbol is crossed out and you can try another one. There is no time limit; only the mistakes are counted.
Levels
Easy: two kinds of symbols in short groups, three answers. Medium: up to three kinds of symbols in longer groups, four answers. Hard: the shape and the filling (solid or outline) each follow their own pattern at the same time.
Hint
The hint marks the right symbol. A game with a hint counts as solved all the same.

Example

In this row a circle and a square take turns. A circle was the last one, so a square comes next.
